checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1, the same page as the itemized prices, which counts as placed correctly for this check.
The Basic Services includesText lists arrangements conference, permits and notices, shelter of remains, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the single basic services fee of $2,195 as a non-declinable charge and does not list a second mandatory facilities or handling fee.
The list does not contain a D-embalming disclosure, so the placement test does not apply.
The list contains no statement that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket services.
The list does not contain a D-alt-container disclosure, so the placement test does not apply.
The list does not offer direct cremation, so the casket-for-cremation test does not apply.
The list does not offer direct cremation, so the wording comparison for the crematory fee does not apply.
The list does not include separate line items for direct cremation or immediate burial, which the check treats as expected itemized offerings.
The list does not offer an optional multi-item package; forwarding and receiving remains are not counted as packages.
The list contains no statement that any purchase is required by law, cemetery, or crematory.
The list contains no claims about delaying decomposition or protecting remains from gravesite substances.
No additional text on the list undercuts a required disclosure and the disclosures present are printed clearly.
